sourceTitle: Stories and ballads for young folks
description: "Stories and Ballads for Young Folks" by Ellen Tracy Alden is a collection of narratives and poems written in the late 19th century. The book aims to entertain and moralize for a younger audience, featuring tales that often include themes of bravery, compassion, and adventure, as well as various charming characters.
